title: ping_l2 native_sim build blockers: coap_client.c send_mutex drift (and recv_async family)
description: Found while debugging project-LICHEN-worker6-5fva.1 on heft (native_sim/native/64, pinned v3.7.0, main checkout): after fixing coap_status.c (strnlen strict-ISO + conversion), ping_l2 still fails to compile at lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_client.c:181 - 'struct coap_client has no member named send_mutex; did you mean send_buf' - coap_client code drifted from the struct definition (likely coap_server/coap_client refactor). Additionally the recv_async 3-arg (user_data) contract migration tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-0l5j blocks: lora_l2_rx.c:139,310,380 (2-arg calls + wrong callback signature), lora_loopback.c:239 (cb invoked with too few args), lora_loopback.c:301 (registration function pointer mismatch). ping_l2 runtime diagnosis (-ENOENT from lichen_link_tx) cannot proceed until these compile. Fix send_mutex drift and coordinate the recv_async migration with 0l5j/sb0b.
close_reason: Fixed the send_mutex drift with a version-conditional: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_client.c now defines LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT_LOCK(client) = &(client)->lock for ZEPHYR_VERSION_CODE >= ZEPHYR_VERSION(4,0,0) else &(client)->send_mutex, replacing both direct uses; +#include <zephyr/version.h>; internal-access WARNING comment updated. Root cause pinned by reference clones: zephyr v3.7.0 (the documented CI pin) struct coap_client has send_mutex (coap_client.h:110 in /home/mark/GIT/zephyr-v3.7.0), v4.0.0 renamed it to lock - the failing builds resolve a v4.1.0 tree because THIS REPO's lichen/west.yml pins v4.1.0 (the 'pinned v3.7.0' in the bead/fleet docs is stale for west-resolved builds; flagged to fleet docs via this note). internal_request fields used (request_ongoing, coap_request.cb/user_data, is_observe, in_callback) verified present in BOTH v3.7.0 and v4.1.0 headers. Verification: native_sim ping_l2 build on the local v4.1.0 tree compiles coap_client.c.obj CLEAN with the fix (build reached 23/32; remaining FAILED TUs are exactly the recv_async family owned by beads 0l5j/sb0b and coap_status.c owned by new bead rmjo - worker7's heft fix for that was never committed, filed rmjo to port it). recv_async call sites deliberately NOT touched here: that migration belongs to 0l5j/sb0b per the bead's 'coordinate' instruction. 3x kimi-k3 codereview: all three passes verified the conditional/macro/hygiene defect-free and converged on two comment-factual corrections (rename happened in v4.0.0 not v4.1.0 - the >= 4.0.0 threshold was already correct; echo_option/send_echo already exist in v3.7.0, only response_ready was dropped) - both applied before commit; no code defects found. Scope note: this closes the named send_mutex blocker only; ping_l2 remains red until rmjo (coap_status.c) and the 0l5j/sb0b recv_async migration land.
